label: preparing
what: A coordinated gathering or celebration in the great hall at eighteen hundred, likely a surprise marking the mayor's forty years of service, disguised as a lighting/provisioning inspection and committee matter. Builder donated lighting; freight reports 143 loaves voluntarily supplied through himself, innkeeper, builder and neighbour, with further deliveries. Baker knowingly supplies bread on innkeeper's personal credit; secretary coordinates the appointment, though neither is proven to know a surprise purpose. The celebratory purpose is inferred, not explicitly disclosed.
